SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL ELEMENTS OF CITING/REFEREE’S REPORT/INCIDENT FOOTAGE
Direct contact to head with a high degree of danger; no mitigation
ESSENTIAL ELEMENTS OF OTHER EVIDENCE (e.g. medical reports)
Incident occurred in the last play of the game.
NZ15 subsequently passed an HIA.
SUMMARY OF PLAYER’S EVIDENCE
Player (“Fiji 6”) reviewed the video footage and accepted the RC and acknowledged the offence. Fiji
6 also noted that the tackle was made in the last play of the game with Fiji defending a narrow lead
and there was no malice in the tackle. Fiji Coach also added that Fiji 6 was attempting to wrap with
his left arm.
FINDINGS OF FACT
Fiji 6 accepted the RC and therefore we move to mitigation.
Reg. 17.18 - Seriousness of the Incident
The first stage is to consider the seriousness of the incident to determine the entry point for the sanction. As
this incident involved head contact, the first note to Appendix 1 of Reg.17 confirms that the entry point must be
at least mid-range. The factors I have considered from Reg.17.18 include:
(a) The tackle was reckless.
(b) The tackle involved shoulder to the head of the ball carrier.
(c) There was no provocation that I am aware of.
(d) The incident was avoidable.
(e) The offence was completed in a reckless manner but without premeditation;
(f) The incident occurred in the last play of the game with Fiji defending a narrow lead. NZ scored from
this play to win the match.
(g) Neither player was injured.
The first note to the World Rugby Sanctions states that:
“Any act of foul play where the person committing the act of foul play makes contact with an opponent’s head
and / or neck, and that contact with the head and / or neck warrants a red card, shall result in at least a mid-
range sanction.”
251130 Disciplinary Decision Vunaki (Fiji) DXB 7s Page 2 of 6

In all the circumstances noted above, I believe that a mid-range entry point of 6 weeks is appropriate.
17.19 Mitigating Factors
The second stage is to consider mitigating factors under Reg. 17.19. Factors I have considered are:
(a) Fiji 6 acknowledged the offence and accepted the RC.
(b) Fiji 6 has never received an RC in his rugby career and has been playing on the international circuit for
3 years without any previous RCs.
(c) Fiji 6’s conduct at the hearing was very polite and respectful.
(d) Fiji 6 was unable to shake hands with NZ15 as he was with the physio at the time but he did try to see
the player.
(e) NZ15 was uninjured and passed a HIA.
For these reasons, I award full mitigation to Fiji 6 of 50% and, therefore, the sanction will be reduced to 3
matches.
17.20 Aggravating Factors
I am not aware of any aggravating factors in this situation.
Matches / tournaments included in the sanction
Total sanction is 3 matches. Matches included in this sanction are:
1. HSBC SVNS DXB - 30.11.26; Fra v Fiji –3rd place play off.
2. HSBC SVNS Cape Town – 06.12.25; Fiji’s first pool match.
3. HSBC SVNS Cape Town – 06.12.25; Fiji’s second pool match.
